Risk: Limited engagement with AI safety research in academia
Problem analysis: Conceptual conflation of AI safety with fairness or narrow application safety
Theoretical insight: Providing peer-reviewed resources clarifies AI safety scope and legitimacy
Design rationale: Leverage validated academic literature in AI safety discussions
Implementation mechanism: Distribute peer-reviewed AI safety papers and arxiv preprints to academics
Validation evidence: Positive engagement and growing openness observed in ~100-200 academic conversations
Intervention: Share peer-reviewed AI safety papers instead of blog posts with academic audiences
Source: https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/SqjQFhn5KTarfW8v7/lessons-learned-from-talking-to-greater-than-100-academics
